objective: Replicate the existing V27d denoising mechanism with an independent pointwise adapter and diagnose why X5A point denoising cannot directly alter Excel TR classification.

source.x5a_label_policy: no_point_labels; filename hints are not point truth

data.input_unit: one event row for Excel TR; one point row for X5A
data.x5a_layout_status: summary_v1_offset74_countN; must be validated before training
data.normalization: existing r20 TR physical feature vector uses fixed physical scales; X5A point adapter uses log1p then train-split median and 1.4826*MAD
data.noise_feature_policy: Excel Noise and derived SNR are excluded, matching r20

denoising.mechanism: V27d-r20 denoising.py unchanged for Excel event rows
denoising.threshold_selection: maximize ClutterTarget score recall subject to DroneTarget and BirdTarget retention floor
denoising.x5a_mode: pointwise protocol-safe quality score; no class prototype and no physical coordinate claim

training.split: inherit sealed r20/r18 parent split for Excel; X5A is external and never enters r20 parent split
training.checkpoint_policy: read-only parent r20 checkpoint; r01 artifacts stay under r01
